content.text: : LV outflow obstruction leads to a fixed CO, ↑ afterload, LVH, & eventually lV failure

Almost always congenital & a disease of the young
: abnormal, retrograde blood flow from the LV into the LA, leading to
rheumatic fever MCC in developing countries

: suggested for pts w/ severe TR despite medical therapy
•mitral valve leaflets bulge into Lt atrium in systole
MVP = MCC of MR in the US

gel like sugar complex build up  -connective tissue dz
